$comment: The single source of truth for the Microsoft Graph APPLICATION permissions Vigil365 requests. Embedded in the installer (GraphPermissions.cs) and the API (GraphPermissionList.cs), read by register-app.ps1, and docs/graph-permissions.md is checked against it by a test. Changing this list after clients have consented means every client's Global Administrator must consent again.

required.name: ThreatHunting.Read.All
required.feature: Advanced hunting (Defender for Identity, Cloud Apps)

optional.feature: Attack simulation results (Graph has no read-only variant; a tenant may refuse it)
